verdict.rationale: Vue's own homepage describes a "truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization," which directly addresses relying on a compiler instead of hand-written diffing. However, this is a single marketing line, with no documentation of how the compiler produces targeted DOM updates. missing for 10: in-depth docs on compile-time optimizations and how surgical updates are achieved, independent or hands-on corroboration of update efficiency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler to translate my components into efficient, surgical DOM updates instead of writing manual diffing code

citations.quote: Truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization.
